description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes for handling QUICHE capsules, including capsule types, capsule data structures, and parsing/serialization logic.

classes.name: Capsule
classes.description: Represents a QUICHE capsule, which can be of various types, and provides static methods for creation and accessors for capsule data.

classes.name: CapsuleParser
classes.description: Parses capsule fragments from a data stream and notifies a visitor upon successful parsing or failure.

methods.name: Capsule::Datagram
methods.description: Creates a Datagram capsule with optional payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagram
methods.description: Creates a LegacyDatagram capsule with optional payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagramWithoutContext
methods.description: Creates a LegacyDatagramWithoutContext capsule with optional payload.

methods.name: Capsule::CloseWebTransportSession
methods.description: Creates a CloseWebTransportSession capsule with error code and message.

methods.name: Capsule::Unknown
methods.description: Creates an Unknown capsule with specified type and data.

methods.name: Capsule::ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the capsule.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::IngestCapsuleFragment
methods.description: Ingests a fragment of capsule data and attempts to parse complete capsules.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::ErrorIfThereIsRemainingBufferedData
methods.description: Checks for remaining buffered data and reports error if any.
